text: I'll start by looking at the workspace layout and finding the pagination code.
The bug is visible at line 31: `end = start + page_size - 1` is an off-by-one, which drops one item per page. Let me read the file to confirm how `end` is used.

Confirmed: `items[start:end]` excludes the element at index `start + page_size - 1`, so every page drops its last item (for page size 5 and 11 items, the items at indices 4, 9 are lost). The slice end should be `start + page_size`.
All 29 tests pass after the change.

args.summary: Fixed an off-by-one in library/pagination.py's paginate(). The slice end was computed as `start + page_size - 1`, so each page excluded its final item (index start+page_size-1). That's why the same items vanished at a regular interval (every page_size-th item). Changed it to `end = start + page_size`. The full test suite passes (29 tests). No test files were modified.
